title: Game Play Analysis III
goal: Show the games each player has accumulated through each recorded day.
strategy: Sort each player timeline, then maintain a running total that resets at the next player. Days with no activity need no invented rows; the total spans all earlier recorded dates.

phasePurposes.start: Show the games each player has accumulated through each recorded day.

edgeCases: Zero-game sessions retain the accumulated total
A device change does not start a new player total
An empty activity table produces no result rows
